creator: @adamdesgns

distribution.documentation_note: The exact tested ZIP retains its earlier documentation. Repository documentation and release notes add the subsequent live smoke-test evidence; the ZIP was not repackaged.

skip_reasons: Windows user could not create the two symlink test fixtures
requirements: Existing eligible Claude subscription with access to the requested model, signed in through the official Claude Code CLI; model entitlement and plan limits are account-specific.
Use require_existing_claude_login=true for the tested personal-subscription workflow. No API key setup is needed for that workflow.
Python 3.11+, Node 22+, HyperFrames 0.8.169, an installed compatible Chromium browser, FFmpeg and ffprobe.
Explicit short writable Windows data root of at most 120 UTF-16 code units; local reviewed seed assets are supplied separately.
limitations: Native Codex desktop installation, host placeholder expansion, fresh-machine setup, other operating systems and other CLI/authentication routes remain untested.
This is one bounded Windows live smoke test; it does not guarantee model availability or success for other users or jobs.
Free plugin source does not mean free inference. Subscription allowances, rate limits and any enabled extra usage remain subject to the user's plan. CLI cost estimates are not invoices.
Model verification occurs after execution and cannot reverse inference or charges already incurred.
The ZIP includes no provider executables, browser, renderer, production assets, private prompts, job logs, credentials or smoke-job artifacts.
license: Existing MIT license for plugin source; third-party software and media retain their own licenses.
